exposure: Cardiac compressions in the delivery room
cohort: 22,550 neonates transported in the first week after birth from 2009 to 2012 in California.
finding: Neonatal transport was more common for infants of Hispanic mothers, mothers <20 years old, mothers with previous cesarean sections, and infants with Apgar score <3 at 10 minutes, cardiac compressions in the delivery room, or major birth defect.
